title: Blasting back!
description: The Pasaana skimmers serve as the perfect vehicle for the group's escape. Rey pilots one of the skimmers, while Poe commands the other. The rest of the crew - Chewbacca. Finn. BB-8 and even C-3PO - all work to deflect the oncoming assault from the First Order, all while racing closer and closer to the downed ship once owned by Ochi of Bestoon.
